## Answer  
The deterministic margin bridge shows that the gross‑margin decline of ‑CAD 10,034 (‑6.78 pp) was driven mainly by a duplicate‑invoice booking error (‑CAD 12,450, ‑3.46 pp) from Maple Ridge Packaging, above‑contract pricing from Sierra Nut Co. (‑CAD 9,116, ‑2.54 pp), and higher sales volume (+CAD 18,873, +1.26 pp) led by Capital Wholesale Grocers, Vanier Village Grocer and Sandy Hill Spices. The duplicate invoice and the excess pricing represent amounts that may be recovered by reversing the erroneous entry and seeking a credit or refund from the respective vendors. [Q-sales][Q-costs][Q-gl][Q-duplicates][Q-overContract][Q-customerShift]

## Drivers  
- **Booking error (duplicate invoice):** –CAD 12,450 (‑3.46 pp) – Maple Ridge Packaging (VEND‑MRP), invoice MRP‑88213. Reverse the duplicate AP/GL entry and seek a credit/refund from Maple Ridge Packaging. [E6-1][E6-2][E6-3][E6-4]  
- **Supplier unit price:** –CAD 9,116 (‑2.54 pp) – Sierra Nut Co. (VEND‑SNC), invoiced above contract for SKUs NUT‑ALM, NUT‑CAS, NUT‑PEC. Claim a credit/refund or negotiate a price adjustment with Sierra Nut Co. [E1-1]  
- **Volume:** +CAD 18,873 (+1.26 pp) – driven by higher units sold to Capital Wholesale Grocers (CUST‑W01, wholesale) 1,102→2,353 units, Vanier Village Grocer (CUST‑R11, retail) 615→934 units, Sandy Hill Spices (CUST‑R10, retail) 571→794 units. Sustain this growth while monitoring profitability. [Q-customerShift][E3-6][E3-7][E3-8]  
- **Customer / product mix:** –CAD 6,517 (‑1.81 pp) – shift toward lower‑margin wholesale channel, principally Capital Wholesale Grocers (CUST‑W01) purchasing higher‑cost SKUs from Sierra Nut Co. (VEND‑SNC). Analyse the mix and prioritize higher‑margin SKUs while maintaining volume growth. [E4-6][E4-8][E4-9]  
- **USD/CAD exchange rate:** –CAD 425 (‑0.12 pp) – unfavorable FX movement increased the CAD cost of USD‑denominated purchases mainly from Sierra Nut Co. (VEND‑SNC). Monitor exposure and consider hedging for future USD purchases. [E5-1][E5-2][E5-3][E5-4]  
- **Packaging spend:** –CAD 399 (‑0.11 pp) – after correcting the duplicate entry, packaging spend with Maple Ridge Packaging (VEND‑MRP) rose slightly. Ensure the invoice is posted only once and review packaging specifications or vendor contracts to control cost growth. [F-h6-r1]  

## Rejected explanations  
- Average selling price per unit showed no change; the bridge attributes CAD 0 (+0 pp) to this driver. [Q-sales][Q-costs][Q-gl]  
- The increase in marketing expense (account 6100) from CAD 8,004 to CAD 42,000 cannot explain a gross‑margin change because operating expenses sit below gross margin. [Q-gl]  

## Unexplained residual  
CAD 0 (+0 pp) [Q-sales][Q-costs][Q-gl]  

## Open questions  
- The mix effect inferred from channel shifts leaves a CAD 4,468 gap unexplained by the bridge’s mix attribution. [F-h3-r2]  
- Whether the rise in marketing expense (CAD 8,004 → CAD 42,000) influenced pricing or volume decisions cannot be determined from the current data. [Q-gl]  
- It is unclear if any additional duplicate invoices beyond MRP‑88213 exist in the AP records for September 2026. [Q-duplicates]  
- The data do not detail whether the foreign‑exchange impact varied significantly across vendors other than Sierra Nut Co. (VEND‑SNC) and Lakeshore Olive Imports (VEND‑LOI). [F-h5-r1]
